description: SSOT for all shadow (box-shadow) token values. No other document defines these values. See PROP-2026-001.

TK-shadow-none.role: No shadow — flat surfaces, default state

TK-shadow-sm.role: Small shadow — subtle elevation, cards on white

TK-shadow-md.role: Medium shadow — dropdowns, elevated cards, hover state

TK-shadow-lg.role: Large shadow — modals, drawers, prominent elevation

TK-shadow-xl.role: Extra large shadow — highest elevation, hero sections
